name: ManualAuto
description: Two-axis assembly: the automatic cycle, with no mode yet.

local.name: Step
local.comment: 0 idle, 1 home, 2 wait, 3 settle, 4 lower, 5 grip, 6 lift, 7 carry, 8 lower, 9 release, 10 raise, 11 return, 12 done

local.name: FreeBase
local.comment: The base blade is open and the assembled base is leaving

local.name: SettleT
local.comment: Wait before the pad lowers on the lid

local.name: GripT
local.comment: Wait for the vacuum to take hold

local.name: LetGoT
local.comment: Wait for the lid to settle on the base

local.name: BaseLeft
local.comment: Wait for the assembled base to leave

local.name: LidGone
local.comment: The pad has taken the lid

local.name: GoQ
local.comment: One scan at the start press

local.name: LidGoneQ
local.comment: One scan when the lid is taken

inputs.name: LidReady
inputs.comment: LidEye.detect: a lid waits at the lid blade

inputs.name: BaseReady
inputs.comment: BaseEye.detect: a base waits at the base blade

inputs.name: XAtMin
inputs.comment: Pick1.xAtMin: the pad is over the lid belt

inputs.name: XAtMax
inputs.comment: Pick1.xAtMax: the pad is over the base belt

inputs.name: Gripped
inputs.comment: Pick1.gripped: the pad holds a part

inputs.name: ModeBtn
inputs.comment: ModeButton.pressed: each press switches between manual and automatic

inputs.name: JogXPlus
inputs.comment: JogXPlus.pressed: jog the pad toward the base belt

inputs.name: JogXMinus
inputs.comment: JogXMinus.pressed: jog the pad toward the lid belt

outputs.name: XPlus
outputs.comment: Pick1.xPlus: move the pad toward the base belt while true

outputs.name: XMinus
outputs.comment: Pick1.xMinus: move the pad toward the lid belt while true

outputs.name: YPlus
outputs.comment: Pick1.yPlus: raise the pad while true

outputs.name: YMinus
outputs.comment: Pick1.yMinus: lower the pad while true

outputs.name: HoldLid
outputs.comment: LidBlade.extend: the blade holds the lid while true

outputs.name: HoldBase
outputs.comment: BaseBlade.extend: the blade holds the base while true

outputs.name: EmitLid
outputs.comment: LidEmitter.emit: put one lid on the lid belt

outputs.name: EmitBase
outputs.comment: BaseEmitter.emit: put one base on the base belt
